events.title: A VETERAN'S PETITION FOR HIS HOUSEHOLD REACHES VALERIUS
events.body: A veteran household represented by Titus Manlius brings a petition concerning the orderly settlement of a family's obligations after years of service. Valerius hears the matter without granting an unrecorded privilege, directing the stewards to distinguish legitimate debts, property claims, and obligations that cannot be established. The petition is entered into the estate's records and the household is given a formal opportunity to produce supporting witnesses. The matter remains open rather than being resolved by personal favor.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.

events.title: MERCHANTS BRING NEWS OF A CHANGE IN THE COMMERCIAL ROUTE BEYOND VALERIUS'S ESTATES
events.body: A pair of merchants arriving from beyond the estate reports that traffic on a more distant commercial route has shifted after difficulties at another crossing. The report is not presented as a military crisis, but it changes which roads merchants expect to use during the winter season. Marcus Lartius records the testimony separately from verified estate accounts, while Quintus Vibius compares the merchants' statements for consistency. Valerius receives the information as intelligence rather than immediately altering the estate's roads or contracts.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Unexpected but causally plausible development emerging from established circumstances, materially changing the information available to Valerius.

events.title: A WINTER ASSEMBLY OF VETERANS TURNS INTO A DISCUSSION OF SERVICE RECORDS
events.body: Several veterans gather to compare old service recollections and records. What begins as an informal meeting becomes a useful reconciliation of names, units, routes, and dates remembered from their service, with discrepancies marked instead of silently harmonized. Servilius and Cassius identify several details worth preserving for the estate archive, while Sextus Tullius records the names of men whose accounts may require further corroboration. No military deployment follows from the meeting.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.

events.title: THE ESTATE LIBRARIES RECEIVE A NEW BATCH OF COPIED MATERIAL
events.body: The estate libraries receive a batch of copied texts acquired through established scholarly and commercial contacts. The librarians catalogue the material by subject and provenance, separating copies whose origins are known from texts whose transmission history remains uncertain. Marcus Petronius oversees the physical inventory while Lucius Marcius compares several copies for obvious differences. The acquisition expands the estate's working archive without altering any financial or political status.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.

events.title: A SMALLHOLDER DISPUTE OVER WATER ACCESS IS SETTLED WITHOUT FORCE
events.body: Two cultivators bring a dispute over access to a shared water channel used by adjoining plots. Gnaeus Fabius and Quintus Cassianus inspect the affected section and hear both claims before recording an arrangement that divides access according to the existing physical capacity of the channel. No guard intervention is required and neither party is dispossessed. The settlement is entered into the estate's local records so the same disagreement does not have to be reconstructed from memory later.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.

events.title: A CIVIC GATHERING GIVES VALERIUS ANOTHER FORMAL OCCASION TO SPEAK
events.body: Valerius appears at a civic gathering connected with the continuing electoral process and addresses those present on matters permitted within the proceeding. Officials record the appearance and the procedural stage, but no vote or result is taken at the gathering. Marcus Claudius Marcellus is present among the political figures observing the proceeding. The event therefore adds a documented public appearance to the candidacy without producing an electoral conclusion.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.

events.title: THE RECURRING SURPLUS CONTRACT SETTLES THROUGH A DIFFERENT WINTER CONSIGNMENT
events.body: The standing surplus-delivery agreement reaches its next settlement after the merchants accept a consignment shaped by the week's available estate surplus and winter transport conditions. Gross receipts reach 42 denarii while current operating and transport costs total 17 denarii, producing 25 denarii of realized net public profit. Under the standing rule, 2.5 denarii is routed to Valerius's private account and 22.5 denarii remains public. The transaction is independently settled rather than copied from the previous delivery.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.

events.title: THE GUARD CONDUCTS A CLOSED EQUIPMENT AND MOUNT INSPECTION
events.body: Titus Varenus conducts a detailed inspection of weapons, tack, mounts, and field equipment with Aulus Rutilius assisting in the inventory. The inspection identifies several items requiring ordinary repair or replacement but does not reduce the force's available strength. The fifty infantry and fifty cavalry remain ready, while the damaged equipment is separated for workshop attention. No expedition or mobilization results from the inspection.

classification_audit.causal_basis: Foreseeable development of an established social, military, scholarly, civic, or commercial circumstance; not merely a continuation of the immediately preceding event.
